ios.desc:
With Streiv you can overlay data from your Strava activities on your videos. Whether you are into running, cycling, skiing, snowboarding, walking.

The supported data from Strava includes:

- speed
- watt
- distance
- heartrate
- altitude
- cadence
- slope 
- temperature

You can scale and position the data as you like and create the video.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app to add Strava data to your videos

quotes.text: This weekend we released an app that enables users to overlay their Strava data like speed or heartrate on to their videos. Streiv is now available on the App Store
